mfg1-electrical-l095.title: Pagtutugma ng rotating machines/transformers sa structure at conditions
mfg1-electrical-l095.objective: Itugma ang structure, starting, loss, detection conditions ng motors/transformers.

paragraphs.title: Rotor at starting
paragraphs.text: Three-phase induction may cage/wound rotors. Star-delta current reduction ay comparison sa same line voltage at angkop na winding. Nagbabago rin starting torque; kaya hindi lahat ng load dahil less current. Itugma ang starting, winding terminals, rating, load, protection.

paragraphs.title: Command at detection
paragraphs.text: Encoder nagsasalin ng angle/linear displacement sa code. Feedback ng servo nagwawasto ng command difference sa position, speed, torque. Ihiwalay ang feed speed at winding torque; huwag position error sa speed increase lamang.

paragraphs.title: Loss at medium
paragraphs.text: May textbook stray-load loss example na 5～30% ng copper loss, ngunit hindi fixed sa lahat. SF 6, sulfur hexafluoride, sa insulation/cooling; tingnan ang environment/handling. Iba ang vacuum/gas arc extinction at oil/molded insulation classifications; huwag sabihing walang old oil breakers.

terms.meaning: Umiikot na bahagi ng motor at iba pa.

mfg1-electrical-l095.activity:
Gabay na 30 minuto: 10 pag-unawa sa teksto, 8 pag-aayos ng halimbawa, 9 pagsulat, 3 pagbalik-tanaw.
Gumawa ng tatlong command examples: position, speed, torque; ipaliwanag detection. Bakit hindi starting current lamang ang star-delta selection, mula load torque/rating?
safety: Tiyakin ang qualification, training, duty scope, at aprubadong procedure sa equipment operation, measurement, machining, o setting change.
mfg1-electrical-l095.summary: Sa motors/transformers, pagsamahin ang structure, gamit, applicability, bukod sa pangalan.
